tasks.title: spec-driven task schema
tasks.description: Add intent, behavior, contracts, outOfScope to the task item; make intent+behavior+acceptance required.

tasks.title: render + embed from single payload
tasks.description: Extend write-tasks.js to render the human Tasks section and emit an embeddable block; brainstorm authors only the payload and embeds it in the issue.
acceptance: write-tasks.js renders the human ## Tasks section from the payload
brainstorm embeds the machine-readable block and no longer hand-writes tasks

tasks.title: pickup materialize + drift-check
tasks.description: On entry, extract the embedded block, materialize + commit .envoy-tasks/<n>.json, warn (non-fatal) on drift.
acceptance: pickup materializes + commits .envoy-tasks/<n>.json from the embedded block

tasks.title: tests
tasks.description: Cover new required schema fields, human-section rendering, materialize-from-issue, drift warning.
acceptance: Tests cover new required fields, rendering from payload, materialize-from-issue, and drift-warning
